characters.name: 许文衡
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone illustrated character sprite for the existing Chinese game Ghost Market Pawnshop, Republican-era Shanghai c.1920s-1930s.
Input image 1 and 2 are ONLY painting-style / material references, NOT people to copy. Image 3 is ONLY the existing game environment and subdued illumination reference; DO NOT render any environment or furniture. Invent an entirely distinct face and silhouette specified below.
Style: restrained semi-realistic opaque gouache; believable Chinese anatomy; purposeful irregular broad brush planes, matte cloth and naturally weathered skin; allow uneven worn surfaces and asymmetric facial structure. Specific real person observed from life, NOT polished stock illustration, not glamour, not a generic same-face NPC. Avoid tiny repetitive mosaic marks everywhere. Same grounded pictorial world as references. Muted earth, soot, worn indigo, desaturated cloth. Gentle warm neutral overhead/front light with soft shadows, not cinematic rim light.
Output: ONE person, vertical 2:3 canvas target 1024x1536. Standing head to UPPER THIGHS, both arms and all hands fully in frame, enough torso below hands for later counter occlusion. Figure alone filling most of the canvas, 5% side clearance, 4% head clearance, lower thighs intentionally end at bottom edge; no cut hands/elbows/hair. Eye-level front/three-quarter viewpoint. No counter/table, no props blocking face, no scenery, no floor, no shadow cast on background. Background SOLID EXACT pure magenta #FF00FF, untextured flat uninterrupted chroma-key, including holes between fingers and arms. No magenta spill or pink on figure. NOT checkerboard. This is game sprite source, not a poster.
No labels, caption, watermark, numbers, readable letters, UI or multiple views. Do not add supernatural signifiers (no red eyes, translucent skin, spectral glow, floating particles, fangs, wounds), nobility ornaments, modern logos, film-star styling or fashion advertising.
Character design to obey precisely:
A very tall, exceptionally slender Chinese male former bookkeeper, age 52; narrow slightly sloping shoulders and a gently stooped back, long bony forearms. His face is a long inverted pear with high hollow temples, large protruding ears, a long convex nose and small pursed lips, clean shaven; receding hair combed straight back with sparse grey at temples. NO glasses. Tired but intelligent dark eyes, one eyelid droops slightly. Unconventionally unattractive, dignified, not sick or menacing. Wears a washed-out brownish olive long cotton changshan, now too loose at shoulders, with carefully mended ivory cuffs; plain dark trousers barely visible. No fashionable waistcoat. Distinct action: torso three-quarter to viewer's left but face turns toward the pawnbroker; one long hand methodically smooths the opposite sleeve at wrist while that other hand rests low with relaxed fingers. A small folded plain cream introduction letter corner tucked inside that sleeve, unobtrusive, no writing. Expression: controlled embarrassment, lips compressed as if calculating his next words, slight chin tuck and gaze up from under brows. He is preserving dignity while short of travel money. Characteristic long thin silhouette, NOT the broad thick-jowled reference man, not a model's elegant pose. Anatomically correct separate hands with natural knuckles, no sale item in hand.

characters.name: 铜镜故事中的丈夫
characters.prompt:
Redesign this ONE ordinary customer sprite for the Chinese game 鬼市当铺. Input 1 is the previous draft ONLY for occupation, general clothing and painterly palette. Input 2 is the actual pawnshop background for matching matte GOUACHE style. The previous draft was rejected for identical symmetrical two-hands-on-counter posing, same faces and blank camera-facing expressions. Completely RECOMPOSE the person's body language, hands, shoulder angle, head angle and facial expression as specified below. It must look like a character caught mid-conversation, an observed human moment rather than a posed lineup. Asymmetric stance, natural weight, plausible anatomy. Make the silhouette, age and facial proportions specific. Do not copy the reference pose. 
Restrained Republican-era Shanghai 1930s realism, opaque hand-painted gouache, clear broad irregular brush shapes, simplify clothing into larger planes rather than uniform all-over crunchy mosaic stippling. Low saturation worn charcoal/indigo/umber/olive cotton, warm understated skin. Everyday people, wrinkles and work wear not glamour. Expression should show a present conversational mood, not hidden honesty, item quality, or redemption outcome. No supernatural effects.
ONE isolated upper-body sprite, square 1254x1254 or closest supported square size, crown and shoulders and all intended hands fully within canvas with 5% margin. Entire figure from crown to upper hip, standing on customer side of a waist-high counter. Camera from player's position at conversational chest/face height, slight view down onto any forward hand. No counter, furniture, scene, text, labels or UI. No pawned goods. Only permitted small occupational accessories specified below. Natural arm occlusion is fine, do not artificially display every finger frontally.
Flat uniformly saturated MAGENTA #FF00FF chroma-key background outside silhouette, no gradients, no texture, no shadows, no magenta lighting spill, no checkerboard. It is a game cutout, not a finished scene.
SPECIFIC REDESIGN: Lean wiry younger hawker around 32, very narrow face, prominent ears, lively narrow eyes, clean shaved jaw instead of the earlier middle-aged stubble. Faded soft brown cap and indigo short jacket with diagonal coarse strap. Torso turned a strong 35 degrees toward image RIGHT as though about to continue down the street, head looking back LEFT toward player. RIGHT hand grips his shoulder strap up at chest height, elbow tucked, LEFT hand at waist makes a small open two-finger conversational gesture toward the player, fingers relaxed NOT a sign. One corner of his mouth lifted mid-sentence in a quick businesslike half-smile, one eyebrow raised. Dynamic but believable shoulders. No bags or pole across face.
characters.identity_decision: 2026-09-17: user fixes cap-wearing original hawker as copper-mirror husband; historical prompt describes its former role only.

Chinese young adult MALE age 24, short-to-average height, very thin and narrow-chested with awkward slightly forward-leaning shoulders, youthful bony wrists. characters.revision_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / precise framing correction. Edit THIS exact character sprite; preserve his exact identity, face, upright head, expression, hairstyle, slender body, pose, plum robe, hands, box design, painting texture and flat pure #FF00FF background. Target canvas 1024x1536 vertical 2:3. Make ONLY a framing correction: reduce the entire existing subject uniformly approximately 7 percent and reposition slightly upward within the canvas so the WHOLE wooden case including its complete bottom corners is visible with at least 50 pixels of plain magenta beneath its bottom. Keep top head margin 35-50 pixels and both hands fully shown. Extend only the necessary lower clothing subtly to bottom canvas if needed; do not invent legs or feet or change proportions. DO NOT crop the case. No new props, text, watermark, environment, outline, shadow, or colored spill. Preserve natural human skin, gouache quality, exact expression, and both original hand gestures.
